title: Single-writer sharded settling with a packed atomic belief word
summary: Partition the lattice by key bits into shards, each owned by exactly one settler actor that is the sole writer of belief state; cross-shard dirty notifications travel over MPSC queues, replacing the global heapq. The Node schema is formally split into three sections decided now: immutable-at-birth (key, moves, priors, evidence), a single atomically-swappable packed belief word (value, variance, mlh, proof/terminal flags in one 128-bit CAS), and append-only concurrent structures (parents list; child_keys slots claimed by CAS). Brokers become pure readers plus edge-claimers; many broker threads feed one GPU request queue.
why_this_architecture: Settling is value iteration over a shared DAG, and backups commute and are idempotent under the gamma=0.997 contraction, so backup ORDER is free â€” single-writer-per-shard plus message-passing preserves the convergence theorem with no locks on the hot path. Virtual loss only diversifies selection; it does not protect reads: a broker reading a torn (value, mlh, variance) triple corrupts every eff_value comparison, which is why the belief must be one atomic word rather than three fields. The races are already visible in the Python: _integrate() writes parent.child_keys[midx] and node.parents.add() while select() reads them; in lattice.py these are plain dict/set/list mutations that cannot survive multithreading.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces SettlingEngine's global heapq dirty queue and the dict-based Lattice (stillwater/search.py, stillwater/lattice.py); formalizes Node.__slots__ into the three-section concurrent schema. This is the part of the compiled core that is design, not porting.

title: Decision-relevance GC with proof compaction (replace clear-on-full)
summary: Replace the v0 eviction (lattice.clear() on over_capacity) with incremental, concurrent mark-and-evict driven by a retention score over root-reachability coloring (recolored cheaply each time the game root advances), evidence mass (evals), and frontier impact â€” never age. Proven subgraphs are compacted to certificates: once a node is proven, its children are freed except a PV witness line, since the broker already prices proven subtrees at zero information. Requires two per-node fields frozen into the schema now (epoch/touch stamp, root-distance color) and deliberately keeps key-indexed child links tolerant of dangling references.
why_this_architecture: The lattice IS the engine's only memory within a game; clear-on-full destroys settled beliefs and proofs precisely in long endgames where the 2.5M cap binds and where the engine is measured weakest. Age-based or LRU eviction is wrong in a transposition-merged graph because old nodes are revisited constantly; decision-relevance (can this node still change the root argmax the court samples?) is the paradigm-native criterion. Proof structure makes a uniquely good GC target here: a proof's subtree is the one thing that can be compressed losslessly, but only if GC understands proofs â€” which it cannot if eviction is bolted on later.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the over_capacity() -> clear() path in engine.think() and extends Lattice with the retention machinery; couples to the proof-certificate proposal (proofs become GC-pinnable compact objects).

title: Evidence-ledger beliefs and a two-tier oracle with fidelity routing
summary: Change the node's mathematical object from one raw oracle reading plus a settled belief to a per-node evidence ledger: (source id, wdl, mlh, precision) entries fused by precision weighting into the prior that backup()'s unexpanded-move fallback and the broker's FPU consume. The broker emits typed eval requests â€” scout tier (small fast net, breadth) and verify tier (BT4, depth) â€” and a router feeds two GPU streams; escalation to BT4 is triggered for nodes the court identifies as decision-relevant (children whose posterior overlap keeps p_best below the bar) or where scout and settled values disagree beyond variance.
why_this_architecture: The paradigm's unifying claim â€” a guess, a lesson, and a proof are one object at three precisions â€” already defines a precision axis; a second oracle just populates more rungs of it, and the variance field plus the court's joint posterior give a principled escalation trigger that tree engines lack. Retrofitting is expensive because raw_value/raw_wdl/raw_mlh are load-bearing at three comparison sites today (FPU penalty in _score_moves, the any_unexpanded fallback in backup, node birth in _create_node); every one must consume the fused prior, so the fusion schema must exist before the compiled core freezes the node layout. This attacks the engine's only fundamental deficit: 450-1665 evals/s of single-fidelity evidence versus Stockfish's millions.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Node (raw_* fields become the ledger) and OracleEval; replaces the single _gpu worker in engine.py with a fidelity router; provides the cost model the deferred trajectory-head pricing ('reach x expected-revision / cost' in search.py's docstring) will plug into.

title: Conditional proof certificates: solve graph-history interaction and rule50 soundness now
summary: proof stops being a boolean and becomes a certificate carrying a validity envelope: an exact bound on plies-to-result (propagated as child bound + 1 through backup) and a rule50-headroom condition (a win proof is valid for a consumer iff 100 - halfmove_clock >= proof distance), plus a repetition-context flag. Every consumer of proof â€” broker skip, court instant-stop, _best_move's proven-win override, proof propagation, GC pinning â€” checks the consumer's clock context against the envelope.
why_this_architecture: Transposition merging on a coarse key (rule50 bucket >>4 capped at 7, binary rep salt) means within-bucket aliasing: a 'mate in 14' proven at halfmove_clock 96 is actually a draw, and the lattice will happily serve that proof to a different path. Proofs are the one belief the engine never re-examines (broker prices them at zero, backup short-circuits on node.proof) AND the thing GC will pin forever, so a single unsound proof is permanent poison â€” this is the classic graph-history-interaction problem, and it must live in the certificate schema because every proof consumer's signature changes. The deferred 'Bedrock' proof modules are only buildable on top of proofs that are actually sound; this proposal is their prerequisite and sharpens that deferred item.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Node.proof/terminal and SettlingEngine.backup's proof-propagation rule (search.py lines 107-109); subsumes and corrects the rule50 salt approximation in lattice.position_key; prerequisite for the deferred Bedrock modules.

title: Continuous search service with root-distribution pondering
summary: Invert control: the eval pump (broker -> GPU -> integrate -> settle) becomes a persistent service owned by the engine process, and 'think' becomes the Root Court attaching a stopping problem to the current root. Pondering is the same pump with the root set to a policy-weighted DISTRIBUTION over the opponent's likely replies (descent entry sampled by opponent prior times our uncertainty); ponderhit means the court attaches to an already-warm root, and a ponder-miss costs almost nothing because work on sibling replies lands in the same shared store via transpositions.
why_this_architecture: In a tree engine, pondering the wrong move wastes the whole tree; here re-rooting is a no-op by construction (lattice.py's own docstring), so STILLWATER is the rare architecture where pondering over a reply distribution is natural and near-lossless â€” no other engine paradigm gets multi-root ponder for free. The engine is evidence-starved (450 evals/s), so opponent time is roughly a 2x evidence multiplier, concentrated exactly in the draw-heavy equal middlegames where p_best stays torn and the court currently runs out of clock. Retrofit is expensive because think() owning the while-loop, reset_flight() per move, and the court's elapsed-from-t0 accounting all assume search exists only inside our own clock.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces engine.think()'s ownership of the batch loop (engine.py lines 117-175); extends Broker.select to accept a weighted root set and the UCI layer to speak ponder/ponderhit.

title: One cost currency: normalized eval units across court, broker, and clock
summary: All deliberation accounting moves from seconds to normalized oracle-cost units (1 unit = one scout eval; a BT4 eval costs its measured ratio, e.g. ~8 units). RootCourt.budgets() emits soft/hard in units; an online exchange-rate estimator (the existing batch_ema generalized into a first-class component) converts clock to units only at the boundary; the broker's leaf-pricing function and the fidelity router draw their cost denominators from the same currency.
why_this_architecture: Stopping-as-inference is already the stated design ('no move-time heuristics exist anywhere else in the engine'), but the posterior responds to information bought, not seconds spent â€” and the moment two oracle tiers with ~10x cost difference exist, wall-clock budgets cannot govern the router at all. This judges the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item insufficient as scoped: it is not just the court â€” broker pricing and fidelity escalation must share the denominator, or proposals for the two-tier oracle and pondering (where elapsed time is meaningless) cannot be governed by one policy. The currency definition must precede the compiled core because it is the interface between court, broker, and router.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the wall-clock arithmetic in RootCourt.budgets/should_stop and engine.think's batch_ema deadline logic; sharpens and absorbs the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item; precondition for the two-tier router and ponder governance.

title: Palimpsest as a per-source Bayesian calibration head over oracle embeddings
summary: Generalize the palimpsest from a context-keyed scalar table to a Bayesian linear head over a compact oracle trunk embedding, learned per evidence source: each lesson (settled value minus that source's raw value) updates a per-source posterior, so the scout net is continuously recalibrated toward BT4-verified settles in-game. The architectural commitments needed now: the ONNX export must expose a trunk embedding output, the node schema reserves a quantized/projected embedding handle (raw 512-d fp16 at 2.5M nodes is 2.5 GB, so the projection/quantization decision is a schema decision), and lessons are tagged with source id.
why_this_architecture: The palimpsest is the 'lesson' rung of the guess/lesson/proof ladder, and palimpsest.py's own docstring already declares the 512-d seam the thing v0 must get right â€” this defines that seam concretely. With a two-tier oracle it is also the paradigm-native cross-calibration mechanism: per-source bias correction is exactly what lets a cheap scout net borrow BT4's calibration mid-game, which no offline training run can do for THIS opponent and THIS game's structures. Retrofitting fails twice over: the node layout is frozen by the concurrent schema, and an ONNX graph without the trunk output cannot be amended without re-export and re-validation of the whole oracle path.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Palimpsest (stillwater/palimpsest.py) from the [n, sum_y] scalar table to per-source linear heads; extends OracleEval and the Node schema with the embedding handle; couples to the evidence-ledger proposal's source ids.

title: The Lens: a single utility object over full WDL beliefs at all comparison sites
summary: Replace the scalar eff_value(v, mlh) with one explicit Utility component u(WDL, mlh, ctx) consulted at exactly the four existing comparison sites (backup argmax in search.py:82, broker scoring in search.py:163, _best_move in engine.py:234, court root_stats in court.py:42), where ctx carries opponent model, match state (must-win/draw-suffices), and side. Core form: u = u_W*W + u_D*D + u_L*L plus a drift-horizon term that generalizes the mlh urge â€” mlh stops being only a conversion compass and becomes an error-exposure horizon (at equality vs a fallible opponent, longer sharp games accumulate expected opponent drift; vs a stronger opponent, shorter games limit our own). This natively supports objective switching: E[value] normally, P(win)=u_W*W in must-win contexts, P(not-loss)=W+D when defending â€” impossible with a collapsed scalar, trivial with the WDL triple. Stored beliefs remain untouched and honest.
why_this_architecture: STILLWATER already committed to the doctrine 'stored beliefs stay honest, transforms only at comparisons' â€” eff_value is a proto-utility proving the seam works. But the architecture's central datatype, the (W,D,L) belief, is wasted at the decision points: every comparison site collapses it to value = W - L first, which deletes the draw mass â€” and the draw mass is exactly where the flat-eval draw problem lives. A node with (0.30, 0.55, 0.15) and a node with (0.15, 0.85, 0.00) both score value=0.15 today; vs SF-3190 the engine has no way to express that it prefers the live one. The lattice paradigm uniquely permits this layer because beliefs are persistent shared objects and decisions are ephemeral â€” a tree engine that tuned its eval with contempt would poison every stored score; here the honest fixed point of the settling operator is preserved while utility changes only which child wins the argmax. This is also the concrete design of the deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility,' which as written is a parameter without a mechanism; the Lens is the mechanism and honors the standing decision of no static contempt (u_D is a function of opponent context, defaulting to 0).
replaces_or_extends: Replaces eff_value (search.py) and its four call sites in search.py, engine.py, court.py; supersedes the deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility' as its designed realization; the Lens is the substrate the Mirror and Effigy proposals plug into.

title: The Mirror: a second settled field per node â€” opponent-conditional value via expectation backup
summary: Add one parallel scalar field v~ ('value under their likely play') to Node, settled by the same dirty queue with a different backup operator depending on whose turn it is: at engine-to-move nodes v~ = max_i(-gamma * v~_child) as now; at opponent-to-move nodes v~ = sum_i p~_i * (-gamma * v~_child), where p~ is the opponent model's move distribution (the stored policy priors temperature-sharpened by the Effigy, unexpanded children priced at raw_value as the frontier already is). The expectation operator with gamma is still a contraction, so the existing settling theory and SETTLE_EPS propagation hold unchanged; one dirty-queue pass settles both fields. The per-node gap g = v* - v~ is the expected opponent regret â€” a derived, searchable measure of trappiness/tension â€” and decisions blend v* and v~ through the Lens with a weight set by estimated opponent strength.
why_this_architecture: This is the answer to 'can the belief lattice represent opponent-conditional values cleanly' â€” yes, more cleanly than any tree engine could. The lattice already stores everything the expectation backup needs at every node (priors, child links, raw_value for the unexpanded mass), side-to-move is baked into the position key so each node has a fixed operator for the whole game, transpositions merge both fields for free, and parent back-pointers mean a revised v~ at the frontier reaches the root in the same prioritized pass as v*. The unifying idea extends naturally: 'value under best play' and 'value under their play' are the same belief object under two different settling operators. This directly attacks the measured failure mode: vs equal opposition every line has v* â‰ˆ 0 and the engine has literally no signal to prefer one flat move over another, so it shuffles into draws; v~ breaks the tie by revealing which 0.00 positions bleed value under fallible play. It also generalizes tension-preservation without hand-coding it: premature simplification is precisely a move that collapses g to zero.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Node (lattice.py) with one field pair and SettlingEngine.backup (search.py) with the expectation operator; supersedes the deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility' jointly with the Lens; the broker's C_VAR-style exploration gains g as a trappiness bonus.

title: The Effigy: an in-game Bayesian opponent model, palimpsest-shaped
summary: A second in-game learner alongside the Palimpsest: a low-dimensional posterior over opponent parameters â€” softmax temperature tau over move utilities plus a blunder-mixture weight eps (and optionally a phase split) â€” updated in closed-ish form after every observed opponent move. The likelihood of their actual move under (tau, eps) is computable from the lattice itself, because the position they just moved from is still resident with full priors and settled child values: one lookup, no extra GPU work. The posterior mean drives the Mirror's p~ and the Lens's parameters (u_D, the v*/v~ blend, the drift-horizon term); like the Palimpsest it is learned mid-game and discarded after. Convergence behavior is the point: against full Stockfish it concludes near-perfection within ~10 moves, switching exploitation off and utility to P(not-loss) â€” losses toward draws; against SF-3000-class play it licenses regret-seeking â€” draws toward wins.
why_this_architecture: Only this architecture gets the likelihood for free: because the lattice persists across moves within a game, the opponent's decision node is already settled with priors and child values when their reply arrives â€” a tree engine re-rooting from scratch would have to reconstruct it. The Palimpsest has already proven the pattern (conjugate in-game posterior, evidence gating, ablation flag, cleared at game end), so the Effigy is the same seam pointed at the opponent instead of the oracle. And it is the component that makes the standing 'no static contempt' decision coherent rather than merely cautious: contempt becomes an inferred quantity with error bars instead of a UCI knob, and the same machinery that wins more vs weaker opponents automatically turns itself off vs Stockfish, where a wrongly-applied contempt would convert draws into losses.
replaces_or_extends: New component parallel to Palimpsest (palimpsest.py is the template); feeds the Mirror's p~ and the Lens's context; engine.py gains one observation hook where the opponent's move arrives (new_game/think boundary).

title: Bounded beliefs: proven floors and ceilings replace the binary proof flag (this is what 'Bedrock' should mean)
summary: Widen the belief datatype from (value, variance, proof: bool) to carry proven bounds [lo, hi]: lo = a value the side to move can force, hi = the best it could possibly achieve. Backup propagates floors cheaply and asymmetrically â€” any single bounded child gives the parent a floor (lo_parent = max_i over evaluated children of -hi_child), no full expansion needed â€” while ceilings require all children bounded, which is exactly the current all-proven condition, so today's proof propagation becomes the lo=hi special case. Repetition and stalemate terminals (which the broker already creates as exact nodes) become floor generators: 'I can always bail to this perpetual/repetition' propagates rootward as a proven draw floor through the same dirty queue. The court gains a new resting condition (chosen move's floor >= draw while behind => snap and bank time), and the Lens can anchor defensive play on floors rather than on noisy net evals â€” Lc0-family nets are notoriously blind to fortresses, and a floor is immune to that blindness.
why_this_architecture: The architecture's founding sentence â€” 'a guess, a lesson, and a proof are the same object at three precisions' â€” is currently only realized for exact values; bounds are the missing intermediate precision, and they slot into the existing machinery with zero new infrastructure: same nodes, same dirty queue, same contraction (bounds are monotone under the max-backup), same court. It is the direct architectural mechanism for losses-into-draws against stronger opposition, which neither the utility layer nor the opponent model addresses: at 450 evals/s STILLWATER will keep losing tactical arguments to Stockfish's millions of nps, but a secured repetition floor is a theorem Stockfish's speed cannot take away, and the engine currently throws that information away the moment a non-draw sibling scores 0.02 higher. The deferred 'Bedrock proof modules' as written is vague; this sharpens it into a datatype change that must be designed before the compiled core freezes the node layout.
replaces_or_extends: Extends beliefs.py and Node (lattice.py); generalizes proof propagation in SettlingEngine.backup (search.py:107) and the proven-win shortcut in _best_move (engine.py:232) and court root_stats; sharpens and replaces the deferred 'Bedrock proof modules' item.

title: Court-directed evidence purchasing: a feedback channel from the court's posterior to the broker
summary: Today the broker is court-blind: it descends by value+prior+variance with no knowledge of which root decision is actually contested, while the court already computes a joint posterior over root candidates (court.py p_best) and then uses it only to stop. Add the reverse flow: the court identifies the contested set (the 2-3 candidates that trade argmax wins in the joint samples) and hands the broker a root-level sampling bias so descents concentrate on resolving that specific comparison â€” information-directed selection denominated in the court's own currency, expected movement of P(argmax) per eval. This also sharpens the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' into a concrete design: court and broker share one unit of account, decision-relevant evidence, instead of seconds on one side and PUCT scores on the other.
why_this_architecture: At ~450 evals/s every evaluation is precious, and the architecture already paid for the expensive part â€” the court's joint posterior exists and is recomputed continuously â€” but the information flows only one way; closing the loop is nearly free and is exactly the 'trajectory-head pricing: reach x expected-revision / cost' future the broker docstring names. The utility proposals make this channel load-bearing rather than nice-to-have: once the Lens is asymmetric, the contested root pair is characteristically (safe drawish move) vs (tense regret-seeking move), and that comparison is settled by deep targeted evidence down the tense line â€” generic variance-chasing spreads the budget across all flat siblings and the engine times out still torn, which is the measured 'torn is the common case at 350 evals/s' lesson already written into court.py's comments.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Broker.select / _score_moves (search.py) with a root-bias input and RootCourt (court.py) with a contested-set output; engine.py's think loop carries the channel; sharpens the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item.

title: The Aquifer: persistent cross-game lattice with variance reheating, evidence-weighted eviction, and an organically grown proof store
summary: Stop clearing the lattice at new_game (engine.py:53) and on capacity (engine.py:158, which currently drains all 2.5M nodes to recover from overflow). Instead, serialize the lattice between games and rehydrate it with 'reheated' beliefs: variance inflated as a function of evidence provenance and staleness (a settled value was conditioned on a frontier that no longer exists, so it must re-enter as a strong prior, not as truth), while proof nodes persist verbatim because they are theorems â€” checkmate proofs, rep-salted draws, and rule50-bucketed terminals are all position-intrinsic given the existing key salting, so the engine organically accumulates a tablebase of endgames it has actually proven. Replace clear-on-capacity with principled eviction by retention value (evidence mass x reachability from recent game positions x proof status). At game end, fuse the actual result as one noisy variance-bearing observation along the played path before persisting, grounding settled beliefs in reality rather than only in search artifacts.
why_this_architecture: This is the affordance no tree engine has: nodes are position-keyed Bayesian beliefs, so transfer across games is literally the same no-op that re-rooting within a game already is â€” the architecture's identity claim ('the lattice IS the transposition table, the learner, and the proof store') is only fully true if the store outlives the game. An opening book falls out for free: early positions recur across games, accumulate evidence, and the broker's existing variance bonus (C_VAR term) automatically spends less there and more on novelty â€” no separate book component needed. The grown proof store directly attacks two stated weaknesses (NO tablebases, historically weak endgame conversion) and gives the deferred 'Bedrock' proof modules a place to write their outputs, raising Bedrock's value rather than duplicating it. Load-bearing: without it, the cross-game learning story reduces to retraining the oracle.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces Lattice.clear() semantics in Engine.new_game and the clear-everything eviction in Engine.think (engine.py:153-163); extends Lattice with serialization, staleness/provenance fields, and a retention-scored eviction policy; adds a game-end outcome-fusion pass.

title: The Distillery: in-play harvest of (position, settled belief, variance, evidence, effort-trajectory) tuples as self-distillation and trajectory-head training data
summary: Add a harvest hook inside Engine._integrate and _create_node â€” the only places a chess.Board exists, since Zobrist keys are not invertible, which is why this must be designed now and cannot be bolted on later â€” that logs, per well-evidenced node, the packed position, raw oracle WDL/mlh, settled WDL/value/variance, evidence mass, proof flag, and snapshots of value at increasing eval counts. This becomes the training corpus for (a) fine-tuning the oracle on settled values (precision-weighted regression using the native variances; proof nodes are exact zero-variance labels), (b) improved policy targets from settled child values, and (c) the deferred trajectory head, whose required supervision â€” 'what will further search conclude at effort k' â€” is exactly the value-at-eval-count trajectory the settling process produces as a byproduct.
why_this_architecture: AlphaZero-style pipelines must generate self-play games to get one noisy outcome label per game; here every think already manufactures thousands of labeled positions, because each node stores BOTH the oracle's prior (raw_wdl) and a strictly-improved posterior (settled wdl) with calibrated uncertainty attached â€” the lattice IS the dataset and it is currently thrown away every game. No other component can raise the ceiling of a frozen BT4; everything else in the engine is decoration on the oracle's residual errors. Judgment on the deferred list: deferring the trajectory-head TRAINING is fine, but the deferral under-specifies â€” the harvest schema serves distillation and the trajectory head simultaneously and must exist before any of it, so design the schema once, now. Load-bearing: this is the only proposal that compounds without bound.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Engine._integrate (engine.py:177-205) and Node (snapshot fields or a side-channel log keyed by node); adds an offline training component; sharpens and partially subsumes the deferred 'training a trajectory head' item by specifying its data source.

title: Hierarchical Palimpsest: multi-resolution contexts with Bayesian shrinkage, plus retroactive repricing through the dirty queue
summary: Replace the single exact context (full 64-bit pawn masks x material counts x stm, palimpsest.py:23-34) with a coarse-to-fine chain â€” e.g. level 0: stm x material-imbalance class; level 1: + pawn-structure family features (islands, passers, locked files); level 2: the current exact key â€” where each level's conjugate-Normal prior is its parent's posterior, and the applied correction is the leaf posterior shrunk through the chain. Additionally store the uncorrected oracle value on the node and make context-posterior movement a first-class dirty-queue event: when a context's correction shifts, re-enqueue that context's nodes so their raw_value is repriced and the settler propagates the consequences.
why_this_architecture: Two architecture-specific reasons. First, the current contexts are so fine that most never reach MIN_EVIDENCE=3 within one game â€” the in-game-learning claim is mostly silent in practice, and partial pooling is the statistically correct fix because lessons (settled-minus-raw residuals) measure the frozen oracle's SYSTEMATIC structural biases, which generalize across exact pawn masks; coarse-level posteriors are also exactly the component that can cheaply persist across games via the Aquifer. Second, raw_value is permanently load-bearing inside backup() as the frontier stand-in for unexpanded moves (search.py:87-96), so repricing it through the existing dirty queue changes settled values across the lattice with ZERO additional GPU work â€” a lesson re-prices positions already in memory, something a tree engine could only achieve by re-searching. Currently corrections only affect nodes born after the lesson; that wastes the architecture's defining mechanism. Load-bearing for the in-game learning story; moderate for raw Elo.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces Palimpsest.context_key and the flat store (palimpsest.py); adds a stored uncorrected oracle value to Node; adds a new information flow Palimpsest -> SettlingEngine.mark_dirty for retroactive repricing.

title: Two-oracle evidence economy: a fast scout net and BT4 fused as precision-weighted measurements, with a cost-aware acquisition broker
summary: Add a second, much smaller Lc0 net (10-20x BT4's throughput) and turn node birth into a Bayesian measurement update: a node's belief is the precision-weighted fusion of whichever oracle measurements it has received, with per-source observation noise CALIBRATED ONLINE from each source's settled-vs-raw residual variance (the palimpsest machinery already computes exactly this statistic). The broker's purchase decision becomes two-armed: at each frontier leaf choose cheap-noisy scout vs expensive-precise BT4 by expected value-of-information per second (reach x expected belief revision / wall-clock cost), and previously scouted nodes can be UPGRADED by a BT4 measurement â€” a re-evaluation path that currently does not exist (every node gets exactly one oracle call ever).
why_this_architecture: Evidence mass is the binding constraint (450 evals/s vs Stockfish's tens of millions), and this paradigm is uniquely positioned to mix evidence qualities: in visit-count MCTS, mixing nets of different strengths corrupts the visit statistics that ARE the value estimate, whereas here beliefs carry explicit variance, so heteroscedastic sources fuse by the algebra the README already promises. The broker's docstring already frames selection as buying information at a price; this makes the price real and heterogeneous. It is complementary to the out-of-scope compiled core (which raises the ceiling of BOTH oracles) but must be designed now because it changes the Node schema (multi-measurement posteriors, source tags), the broker's scoring objective, and â€” sharpening a deferred item â€” it forces the deferred eval-denominated court budgets to be denominated in SECONDS, not evals, since evals no longer have uniform cost. Load-bearing: the largest near-term strength delta available at design level.
replaces_or_extends: Extends LeelaOracle into an oracle portfolio with per-source noise models; replaces single-shot node birth in Engine._create_node with a fusion/upgrade update; extends Broker._score_moves into a cost-aware two-armed acquisition rule.

title: Honest max: bias-aware distributional backup so interior variances mean what the broker, court, and palimpsest assume they mean
summary: Replace the backup's variance bookkeeping â€” currently the parent inherits the single best child's variance verbatim (search.py:101-103) â€” with a posterior over the max: a soft-Bayes-max contraction (log-sum-exp with temperature tied to child variances, still a contraction under gamma) whose mean corrects the winner's-curse upward bias of argmax over noisy estimates and whose variance inflates with top-2 ambiguity, computed in WDL space since children already carry full distributions. This is essentially running a lightweight version of the Root Court's joint-posterior reasoning at every backup instead of only at the root.
why_this_architecture: The paradigm's core claim is that lattice values are honest calibrated beliefs, but the settling operator is point-mass value iteration with bolt-on variance, and three consumers are silently poisoned by it: the broker's C_VAR exploration bonus targets miscalibrated uncertainty; the court's stopping posterior treats biased interior values as Gaussian means (plausibly contributing to the observed flat-eval draw-heavy behavior, where 'genuinely drawish' and 'unresolved but ambiguous' are indistinguishable); and worst, the Palimpsest learns from settled-minus-raw residuals (engine.py:201), so max-bias at high-branching nodes is ingested as if it were oracle pessimism â€” the learner learns the search's optimism. Every other proposal here (fusion weights, distillation loss weights, reheated persistence priors) consumes these variances, so this is foundational plumbing for all of them.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the value/variance/wdl assignment inside SettlingEngine.backup (search.py:63-115); the Root Court keeps its role but its inputs become calibrated; no new components, one changed mathematical operator.

title: Evidential WDL beliefs: Dirichlet posteriors with explicit precision (epistemic vs aleatoric split)
summary: Replace each node's (wdl tuple, scalar variance, evals) with a Dirichlet posterior over (W,D,L) whose concentration is earned evidence: an oracle eval contributes a fixed pseudo-count, backups carry the supporting child's concentration, and proofs are infinite concentration (variance-zero falls out as a limit instead of a special case). Epistemic uncertainty becomes the variance of the value of the Dirichlet mean, roughly aleatoric/(1+S), and is the only uncertainty the broker and court are allowed to consume; aleatoric sharpness (w+l)-(w-l)^2 remains available but is never again used as exploration fuel. This deletes the scattered ad hoc /(1+n) shrinkages in court.p_best and the broker's C_VAR term, which are currently doing a conjugate posterior's job by hand and inconsistently.
why_this_architecture: The paradigm's founding slogan â€” a neural guess, a lesson, and a proof are the same object at three precisions â€” is currently a metaphor, because precision is not represented anywhere. beliefs.py's variance conflates 'this position is genuinely drawish or sharp' (aleatoric, never shrinks) with 'the oracle might be wrong here' (epistemic, must shrink with evidence): a dead-drawn endgame screams maximum uncertainty forever while a sharp position the net is confidently wrong about whispers. A belief lattice that cannot say how much it believes itself cannot price information, and pricing information is the broker's and court's entire job. The Dirichlet makes the three-precisions slogan literal and gives every downstream consumer one coherent precision currency.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces beliefs.py's variance semantics and Node's (wdl, variance, evals) fields in lattice.py; consumed by SettlingEngine/Broker in search.py and RootCourt in court.py. Substrate for the other proposals.

title: Distributional max-backup: the parent inherits the posterior of the max, not the max of posteriors
summary: SettlingEngine.backup currently sets the parent to the plug-in argmax child and inherits only that child's variance and WDL, so the 'which child is actually best' uncertainty vanishes from the lattice and the winner's curse (max over noisy estimates is biased upward) inflates every interior node. Replace it with a moment-matched posterior of max_i(-gamma*V_i) over the children's posteriors (Clark's pairwise max-of-Gaussians approximation, O(children) per backup): the parent mean receives the selection-bias correction, the parent variance includes argmax ambiguity, and the parent WDL and mlh become the P(child i is best)-weighted mixture of flipped child beliefs. This also makes the conversion urge coherent: with (outcome, horizon) propagated jointly, eff_value becomes an expected-utility readout of the stored belief instead of a multiplier applied at some comparison sites and not others.
why_this_architecture: The lattice's claim is that stored beliefs 'stay honest,' yet the hard max over uncertain beliefs is the single largest dishonesty in the system â€” it is the alpha-beta reflex smuggled into a Bayesian object. In a value-iteration architecture the bias compounds rootward through hundreds of plies of backups, and the court then makes clock decisions on systematically over-optimistic, over-confident root posteriors. This directly attacks the measured pathology of draw-heavy optimism (holding a flat eval while believing itself slightly better, game after game vs UCI_Elo 3190) and gives the court honest variance to stop on.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the core of SettlingEngine.backup in search.py (the best_q/best_child inheritance block); depends on the evidential-belief substrate.

title: Posterior-sampling broker: Thompson descent with a learned prior-predictive (retires PUCT, FPU, and virtual loss)
summary: Replace _score_moves entirely: at each node, sample every move's value â€” expanded children from their evidential posteriors, unexpanded moves from a prior predictive Normal(parent.raw_value + delta(policy prior), sigma0) where delta is an online-learned regression of first-eval child value against log policy prior (palimpsest machinery replacing the FPU_PENALTY constant with a measured curve) â€” and descend the argmax of the samples. Proven children participate at their exact value, so siblings are bought only when their sampled value beats the guaranteed floor; batches diversify through sampling randomness, so VLOSS disappears; at the root, bias selection toward the top-two posterior contenders (top-two Thompson sampling), a near-optimal best-arm-identification rule for exactly the question the court is asking.
why_this_architecture: The broker's own docstring admits it is a stand-in for 'reach x expected-revision / cost,' but PUCT optimizes a cumulative-regret bandit objective that does not exist here: no payoff accrues during search; the only payoff is whether the move the court will pick changes. Thompson descent spends evals in proportion to the posterior probability that a line is decision-relevant, collapses four hand-set constants (C_PUCT, C_VAR, FPU_PENALTY, VLOSS) into one mechanism with zero tunables, and fixes a concrete betrayal: today a proven-draw child is skipped in scoring, so the broker buys evals on siblings whose entire posterior lies below the guaranteed draw â€” pure waste exactly where lost positions need a save. At 450 evals/s, eval allocation IS the engine; this also sharpens the deferred trajectory-head item by defining precisely what that head should predict (expected sample-flip probability per descent).
replaces_or_extends: Replaces Broker._score_moves and the FPU_PENALTY/VLOSS/C_PUCT/C_VAR constants in search.py; the descent loop in Broker.select keeps its terminal/transposition plumbing. Sharpens the deferred 'training a trajectory head' item.

title: Regret-denominated stopping: the court minimizes expected game-point loss, not P(argmax)
summary: Replace the EARLY_STOP_P/LATE_STOP_P/EXTEND_FACTOR thresholds with expected-regret stopping: from the same joint samples the court already draws, compute R = E[max_i q_i - q_argmax] in game-point (WDL-utility) units, and stop when R falls below the marginal game-point value of a second of banked clock â€” a strength-vs-time curve estimable online, which makes bank protection a property of the curve rather than a hand-set extension factor. The utility vector used to score WDL is also the natural home for opponent-aware draw values: the deferred draw-utility item reduces to three numbers fed into this regret computation rather than a separate mechanism.
why_this_architecture: P(argmax is best) is the wrong loss for a court that calls itself decision-theoretic: it cannot distinguish 'torn between two near-identical moves' (regret ~0, should snap instantly) from 'torn between a win and a blunder' (same P, enormous regret) â€” and court.py's own comments record exactly this failure draining the clock in flat middlegames vs SF-3000. 'Stopping as inference' about the wrong quantity is still a heuristic. This sharpens and largely subsumes the deferred eval-denominated-budgets item: the honest denomination is expected game points per second, not evals per move.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces RootCourt.should_stop's threshold logic and EXTEND_FACTOR; extends RootCourt.budgets with a value-of-time curve. Subsumes the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' and absorbs 'opponent-aware draw-utility' as the utility vector.

title: Correlated root posterior with prior-predictive arms for unexpanded moves
summary: The court's posterior treats root children as independent Gaussians and silently omits every unexpanded root move â€” p_best can clear the stopping bar while a high-policy-prior move has zero evaluations. Fix one: estimate root-child covariance empirically from the time series of per-settle-epoch root q-vectors (exponentially weighted covariance over epoch deltas captures shared-subtree and shared-oracle-bias correlation for free) and sample jointly with it, since the decision-relevant quantities are the differences q_best - q_i in which common bias cancels. Fix two: enter unexpanded root moves as prior-predictive arms using the learned policy-prior-to-value curve, so confidence is structurally impossible while a plausible move remains unbought.
why_this_architecture: The belief lattice is specifically the architecture in which root children are NOT independent â€” transpositions are the whole point, so root subtrees physically share nodes, and the independence assumption overstates confidence exactly when the lattice is doing its job best. And omitting unexpanded moves contradicts the broker's own stated design principle ('the frontier never collapses onto a poor explored subset') at the one node where collapse decides the game.
replaces_or_extends: Extends RootCourt.root_stats and RootCourt.p_best in court.py; reuses the prior-predictive component from the posterior-sampling broker.

title: Palimpsest as a live lattice layer: hierarchical contexts with retroactive re-pricing
summary: Make palimpsest contexts first-class lattice citizens: each context posterior keeps back-pointers to its member nodes, and when its mean moves beyond epsilon the settler re-prices those nodes' raw_value and marks them dirty â€” so a lesson retroactively re-prices positions already in the lattice, not only nodes born afterward. Add a two-level hierarchy (material signature as parent, exact pawn-structure context as child) with shrinkage, so a fresh pawn-push context inherits its parent's posterior instead of staying mute below MIN_EVIDENCE; and make lessons repeated residual observations (settled minus corrected-raw, observation noise shrinking with subtree evidence) instead of one snapshot at evals==32, which removes the current correction-echo where settled values already contain descendants' corrections and get counted as fresh evidence.
why_this_architecture: palimpsest.py's docstring claims corrections 're-price positions the search has never visited,' but the implementation only prices future node births â€” stale beliefs keep their stale raw_value forever. The persistent, transposition-merged, back-pointered lattice with a prioritized dirty queue is precisely the structure that makes retroactive re-pricing nearly free, and no tree-search engine could even express this information flow; failing to wire it is leaving the architecture's signature capability (mid-game self-revision) half-connected. The hierarchy matters because exact pawn-mask contexts shatter on every pawn move, so v0's lessons die young.
replaces_or_extends: Extends palimpsest.py (hierarchical store, residual observations), Node/lattice.py (context membership links), SettlingEngine (a second dirty-queue source), and Engine._integrate's lesson-ingestion path in engine.py.

title: Syzygy as a Proof Oracle tier in the broker (the lookup half of 'Bedrock', un-deferred)
summary: Add a second oracle beside the neural one: when a broker descent reaches a <=6-man position, probe Syzygy WDL instead of spending a GPU slot, and admit the result through the existing terminal-admission seam as a variance-zero pinned belief; DTZ probes near the root pin mlh so the eff_value conversion urge becomes exact rather than a neural guess. Probing must be rule50-bucket-aware (cursed wins / blessed losses resolve differently per halfmove-clock bucket), which the lattice's existing R50-salted keys are already shaped for. One TB hit deep in an ending then proof-propagates rootward, the broker prices the proven subtree at zero and reallocates the whole GPU budget to the unproven boundary, and the court's 'a theorem ends deliberation' rule snap-moves.
why_this_architecture: In alpha-beta a TB hit is a score that needs careful interaction with bounds and search; here a tablebase IS the native object â€” a proof oracle emitting the third precision of the design's own 'guess/lesson/proof are one object' creed, with zero impedance mismatch (Node.make_terminal already exists, proof propagation already exists, the court already terminates on proofs). It also targets the two biggest measured weaknesses at once: endgame conversion (historically weak, only mitigated by the mlh urge) and draw-heaviness vs equals â€” at 450 evals/s STILLWATER will never out-grind Stockfish endings by evaluation, but it does not have to if it can touch bedrock. The deferred 'Bedrock proof modules' item is too vague and defers the wrong half: TB lookup needs design NOW (bucket-aware probe semantics, DTZ-to-mlh flow, WDL-belief mapping for cursed results).
replaces_or_extends: Extends Broker._terminal_value / leaf admission in stillwater/search.py and Node.make_terminal in stillwater/lattice.py; sharpens and partially un-defers 'Bedrock proof modules'.

title: Saturation-triggered proof bursts: a CPU proof-number-search micro-prover on the lattice (the construction half of 'Bedrock')
summary: A bounded PNS module that fires when a belief saturates (|value| > ~0.9 with forcing moves present) or when the court is torn between near-certain candidates, and tries to promote the near-certainty into an exact mate/draw proof within a small node budget. PNS is DAG-native â€” it runs ON the lattice sharing the same nodes (proof/disproof numbers are one more annotation slot), and successes enter as variance-zero pinned beliefs through the existing proof-propagation machinery. It runs on CPU cycles that are idle while the GPU evaluates a batch.
why_this_architecture: The architecture's slogan says a guess and a proof are the same object at different precisions, but today there is no operator that PROMOTES a belief from second to third precision except accidental exhaustive enumeration of terminal children â€” PNS is exactly that missing promotion operator. It is also the lattice-native answer to the one battle-proven failure class of PUCT+NN at low evals/s: policy-blind shallow tactics (the engine's own WAC.001 Qg6 miss at 8 seconds) and slow conversion of clearly won positions; check extensions and mate-distance pruning from the alpha-beta world do not transfer as mechanisms, but their essence â€” exhaustive treatment of forcing lines â€” is PNS's home turf. A proof also instantly ends court deliberation, converting tactical sharpness into banked clock.
replaces_or_extends: New component beside the Oracle; extends SettlingEngine proof propagation (stillwater/search.py backup, lines ~107-109) and Node storage; consumes idle CPU in Engine's batch loop; concretizes the deferred 'Bedrock proof modules' with a trigger-and-budget design that must be specced before the compiled core.

title: Perpetual settling: pondering as a non-event, plus lattice-resident evidence accounting in the Court
summary: The deliberation loop never stops: on opponent time the broker simply descends from the opponent-to-move position, and selection naturally spreads effort across the opponent's plausible replies in proportion to priors and values â€” expectation pondering with no ponder-move guess and no ponderhit/miss machinery, because the lattice never re-roots. The design work that must happen now is in the Court: evidence gating is currently session-denominated (evals_this_move >= max(256, 2*batch) in engine.py line 128, plus 'never move on zero fresh evidence'), which would discard pondered work; min-work and stopping must be re-denominated in lattice-resident evidence (root-cone eval mass and posterior movement), so a root pre-settled on opponent time snap-moves in milliseconds and banks clock.
why_this_architecture: Tree engines pay for pondering with re-rooting, tree-reuse bookkeeping, and a ~50% ponder-miss tax; STILLWATER's founding premises â€” position-keyed beliefs, free transpositions, re-rooting is a no-op â€” make opponent-time deliberation literally free, and refusing it wastes roughly half of wall-clock for an engine whose binding constraint is 450 evals/s. It compounds with the engine's hardest-learned lesson (horizon-aware budgets after endgame clock starvation): pondering plus snap-moves on pre-settled positions is a clock-banking machine. This also subsumes and sharpens the deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item â€” the right denomination is root-cone belief mass, not session eval counts, and that interface must be designed before the compiled core freezes the loop structure.
replaces_or_extends: Extends Engine.think (stillwater/engine.py) into a persistent loop with the court attached per-decision; replaces the court's session-based min_work/fresh-evidence gates (stillwater/court.py should_stop, engine.py line 128); subsumes deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets'.

title: WDL-utility algebra at comparison sites: contempt and draw-handling done natively
summary: Replace the scalar eff_value(v, mlh) with a utility functional U(w, d, l, mlh; theta) over the full WDL belief, where theta carries a draw price (contempt, set from opponent strength or must-win match state) alongside the existing conversion urge, applied at exactly the same three comparison sites (backup argmax, move choice, court) while stored beliefs stay honest. The court samples in utility space and its uncertainty becomes variance of utility rather than variance of the raw outcome variable.
why_this_architecture: STILLWATER already stores and propagates full outcome distributions at every node â€” backups carry the best child's WDL tuple rootward â€” and then throws the draw mass away by collapsing to W-L before every comparison; the information contempt needs is already flowing and is merely being discarded at the last step. Stockfish contempt is an eval-offset hack and Lc0's WDL contempt (battle-proven Elo vs weaker opposition) had to be retrofitted onto a scalar pipeline; this is the one architecture where it is a one-line change of comparison operator. The measured behavior demands it: draw-heavy vs equals, repeated flat-eval draws vs UCI_Elo 3190. The deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility' is the right idea but must be designed jointly with eff_value and the court's sampling space NOW â€” the codebase already learned (with eff at all three sites) that comparison operators must agree everywhere or backup argmax and court argmax diverge.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces eff_value (stillwater/search.py) and its call sites in backup, _best_move, and court.root_stats; extends stillwater/beliefs.py with the utility functional; changes court.p_best to sample in utility space. Sharpens deferred 'opponent-aware draw-utility'.

title: Decision-relevance field: a root-to-leaf influence flow that replaces local PUCT pricing (what LMR/null-move actually mean here)
summary: Add a second propagated quantity flowing opposite to value backups: each node carries an influence weight approximating P(a shift in this node's belief changes the root decision), computed by chaining softmax-of-children responsibilities down from the root and refreshed lazily along descents and after settling waves. The broker's leaf price becomes influence x expected-belief-revision (variance per evidence) instead of purely local Q+U terms, and the court's verdict feeds back into selection: when torn between two root moves, the field automatically concentrates budget on the discriminating subtrees â€” the native form of singular extensions.
why_this_architecture: Alpha-beta's efficiency miracle is not depth, it is decision-relevance pruning â€” windows are proofs that a subtree cannot affect the root choice; LMR, null-move, aspiration windows, and killer/history tables are tree-shaped carriers of that idea plus move ordering (which the policy head already supplies natively) and genuinely do not transfer as mechanisms. STILLWATER currently has no carrier for the essence: C_VAR's bonus is local, and the Court computes the exact decision posterior but uses it only to STOP, never to STEER â€” a court-to-broker information flow that simply does not exist today. This is also the honest v1 of the docstring's own promise ('trajectory-head pricing â€” reach x expected-revision / cost'): reach IS the influence field, computable from the lattice now and trainable later. At 450 evals/s no engine in the field can less afford irrelevant evaluations. Multi-PV, judged here: it needs no architecture at all â€” the court posterior already yields top-k moves with P(best), strictly richer than tree multipv; report it and move on.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces Broker._score_moves local pricing (stillwater/search.py); extends Node with an influence slot; creates the missing Court-to-Broker feedback edge; is the designed-now precursor of the deferred 'trajectory head'.

title: Sediment layer: opening preparation as imported prior beliefs
summary: A read-only, disk-resident shard of pre-settled beliefs (position key -> WDL, variance, evidence mass, priors) consulted at node birth through the same seam as the palimpsest correction. Book construction is just running the engine's own settling offline (or distilling Lc0/SF prep) and serializing the opening cone; at the board, a well-evidenced imported belief makes the court clear its bar instantly and snap-move, while a refuted book line is self-correcting because imports carry nonzero variance and finite evidence that live settling can outvote.
why_this_architecture: Every top engine ships opening preparation; STILLWATER re-derives move-5 theory at 450 evals/s on the clock, squandering its hard-won banked-time discipline in the one phase where answers are precomputable. The lattice-native translation is uniquely clean: a book is not a move list with a separate arbiter and an out-of-book cliff â€” it is just MORE LATTICE, pre-settled, entering through the existing belief algebra, indistinguishable in datatype from live search. The 'NO persistence across games' principle should be sharpened rather than dropped: no learned persistence (the palimpsest still dies with the game), but read-only prep import is a different epistemic category â€” priors, not lessons.
replaces_or_extends: Extends the node-birth seam in Engine._create_node (stillwater/engine.py, same injection point as palimpsest.correction); relaxes the no-cross-game-persistence rule for read-only priors only.

title: Metabolic eviction: forgetting as compression into the palimpsest, replacing clear-all
summary: Replace the over-capacity drain-the-pond (engine.py lines ~153-163) with graded retention: never evict proofs or the root cone; evict lowest (influence x variance x evidence-staleness); and route each evicted well-evidenced node's lesson (settled minus raw value) through palimpsest.observe on the way out, so eviction is lossy compression of position-level beliefs into the context-level posterior rather than amnesia. The retention priority must be computable from Node fields, which is why it must be designed now â€” it dictates the compiled core's memory layout.
why_this_architecture: The current clear-all detonates in exactly the games that matter: long grinds where 2.5M nodes is reached as the endgame begins â€” the phase the engine is already weakest in â€” and both perpetual settling and the compiled core multiply fill rates 10-100x, turning eviction from a rare event into per-move routine. The paradigm itself dictates the design: if a guess, a lesson, and a proof are one object at three precisions, then forgetting is DEMOTION across precisions (a settled node survives as a palimpsest lesson, a proof survives verbatim), not deletion. Transposition-table replacement-scheme wisdom from tree engines (depth-preferred ~ evidence-preferred, aging generations) translates directly; the clear-all does not.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the over-capacity clear-all in Engine.think (stillwater/engine.py); extends Palimpsest as the eviction sink; consumes the influence field of the decision-relevance proposal when present (degrades to evidence x variance without it).

title: Validity-domain beliefs with occurrence-aware keys (graph-history closure)
summary: Replace write-time aliasing (16-ply rule50 buckets, binary rep salt applied only when creating terminal nodes) with read-time domain checking: every belief carries the validity domain it was derived under â€” rule50 headroom at derivation and game-occurrence count (0/1/2+, known exactly from the true path via board.is_repetition(2) at node creation, which should also fold into the key) â€” and a lookup whose path falls outside the domain treats the stored belief as a prior to refine, not a truth to inherit. Two verified triggers: (a) a node whose value was settled via a path entering at halfmove_clock=96 is trusted verbatim by a path entering at hm=98 in the same bucket, even when the winning line needs more plies than the 50-move rule leaves â€” and bucket boundaries make this systematic in fortress grinds and 50-move races; (b) when the game itself re-reaches a position (second occurrence), position_key maps the root to the first-occurrence node, so beliefs settled when the opponent needed two more repetitions to draw are reused when one suffices â€” and because the lattice persists within the game, the accumulated evidence mass makes the court snap confidently on exactly the stalest values (consistent with the observed flat-eval draw streaks vs equals). The write side must also be made coherent: the oracle input is explicitly path-conditioned (raw rule50 plane 109, 8-ply history repetition flags) but is cached first-writer-wins under a path-coarse key; either canonicalize oracle inputs to the key's equivalence class or record the conditioning in the domain. Zobrist collisions were examined and dismissed: ~2e-7 expected collisions per full 2.5M table at 64 bits â€” the deliberate salt aliasing is orders of magnitude more probable and is the binding soundness risk.
why_this_architecture: The lattice's founding bet is that position-keyed beliefs transpose for free, but chess values are path functions (rule50, repetition), so a single global store necessarily caches path-dependent numbers under path-coarse keys â€” a tree engine gets path correctness for free and never faces this; the belief lattice must solve it explicitly or it is formally unsound, not just inaccurate. Salting tries to solve it at write time and provably cannot (finite buckets, terminal-only rep salt); domains solve it at read time while preserving the transposition sharing that justifies the whole design. It is also the natural completion of 'guess, lesson, and proof are one object at three precisions': a precision claim without a statement of where it holds is not a claim.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the keying semantics of position_key in stillwater/lattice.py and extends the Node belief object with a domain field; changes lookup/linking behavior in Broker.select and Engine._integrate. Subsumes the rep-salt and rule50-bucket scheme rather than tuning it.

title: Proof certificates with consumption budgets and a revocation flow
summary: Turn the boolean proof pin into a certificate: (certifying child edge, exact mate/draw distance, reversible-ply budget consumed along the critical path), with budget arithmetic propagated in backup (parent budget = child budget + 1 reversible ply; reset at captures/pawn moves) and a validity bound checked against the actual entry halfmove clock. Add the inverse information flow â€” anti-proof propagation: when a certificate's domain is violated, or its certifying child is revised or evicted, the proof un-pins and the existing dirty queue carries the retraction rootward. As implemented, proof=True early-returns in backup() forever, the broker stops searching proven subtrees, and proven-losing children promote parents irreversibly â€” so a single false proof created through a rule50-aliased key (e.g., a KQ-vs-KR 'mate' needing 20 reversible plies found with 6 plies of actual headroom) is permanent poison that propagates upward and ends court deliberation instantly (a 'theorem ends deliberation').
why_this_architecture: The architecture's most distinctive claim is that proofs are just variance-zero beliefs participating in the same propagation as guesses â€” that is only sound if pins can never be wrong, and under key aliasing they can be; a belief system that can pin but never retract is formally unsound the moment one pin is false. The settling engine's dirty queue is already the perfect retraction channel, so revocation is a new flow through existing machinery, not a new subsystem. This also sharpens the deferred 'Bedrock proof modules' item: the modules can stay deferred, but the proof lifecycle (certificate algebra, budgets, revocation) must be designed now, because bolting Bedrock onto a boolean proof flag later bakes the unsoundness into the compiled core.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the proof flag and the proof-propagation branch in SettlingEngine.backup (stillwater/search.py) and the proven-win shortcuts in Engine._best_move and RootCourt; sharpens (does not duplicate) the deferred Bedrock item.

title: Certainty-stratified ordering: divorce contraction from value semantics
summary: Stop using gamma=0.997 simultaneously as the convergence contraction and as the preference order: store undiscounted beliefs plus an explicit distance-to-resolution field, and compare lexicographically by certainty class (proven > heuristic), then value, then distance, at every comparison site. As implemented, a certain win n plies out is worth 0.997^n, so any forced win beyond ~35 plies loses the interior backup argmax to an unproven 0.9 hunch (the proven-win override exists only in _best_move, not in backup), 'all_proven' nodes store discounted values like 0.997^k so a deep enough proven result even falls below the >0.5 proof-recognition threshold, and through transpositions the discount a stored value carries reflects settle-topology distance rather than game distance â€” the same number means different things to parents at different depths, which is incoherent in a shared graph. Keep damping purely as a cycle-contraction device on belief updates; this also retires the 12% eff_value mlh nudge (which cannot offset the discount past ~45 plies) and the stale raw_mlh (frozen at node creation, never re-queried) as comparison inputs. Trigger is the engine's own measured weakness: KBN# and long conversions live exactly in the 40-80-ply regime where the discount prefers the wrong move.
why_this_architecture: In a tree, gamma-discounting is a tolerable depth-preference proxy because every node has one depth; the belief lattice is precisely the structure in which a node has no unique depth, so discount-as-semantics breaks here and only here. And the paradigm already owns the right objects â€” mlh/distance is a first-class field and proofs are a first-class precision tier â€” so lexicographic (certainty, value, distance) is the comparison rule this architecture was always implying: certainty should never be exchangeable for heuristic optimism at a fixed 0.3%-per-ply rate.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the GAMMA-discounted ordering at all comparison sites (SettlingEngine.backup argmax, Broker._score_moves, Engine._best_move, RootCourt.root_stats) and subsumes eff_value/MLH_W; gamma survives only as the cycle-damping device inside the settle step.

title: Epistemic/aleatoric variance split and a covariance-aware Root Court
summary: Split Node.variance into two channels: aleatoric (WDL outcome entropy â€” what is stored today) and epistemic (estimate error: empirical second moment of backup revisions at the node, raw-vs-settled disagreement across its subtree, palimpsest-correction posterior variance, and domain-mismatch penalties from the validity-domain proposal); the court samples epistemic only. Today p_best uses outcome entropy divided by eval count as if subtree evals were iid outcome draws, so a confidently wrong oracle (a fortress scored Wâ‰ˆ0.9) yields tiny variance and the court stops at 0.93 on a losing move after minimal work; conversely, root moves that transpose into the same subtree literally share lattice nodes yet are sampled as independent Gaussians, so the court stays 'torn' between identical-by-construction values and burns banked clock. Fix correlation with the lattice's own structure: shared-evidence mass between root-child subtrees (countable during the existing path-increment pass in _integrate) becomes the covariance of the joint posterior. This also repairs the palimpsest seam: corrections currently shift raw_value with their uncertainty discarded and are frozen at node creation (later lessons never reprice existing nodes, contradicting the module's own docstring) â€” correction variance and staleness belong in the epistemic channel.
why_this_architecture: 'Stopping as inference, zero time heuristics' is the architecture's proudest claim, but the inference is currently over a statistical fiction in both directions. The graph that invalidates the independence assumption â€” transposition merging â€” is the same graph that hands the court the covariance for free; a tree engine could not compute this, the belief lattice gets it as a by-product. The epistemic channel is also what makes evidence mass stop being poison after context shifts (second occurrences, palimpsest revisions): stale confidence should widen, not narrow. The deferred 'eval-denominated court budgets' item is orthogonal and does not address this â€” the posterior itself is wrong, not the budget's units.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the single variance field (stillwater/beliefs.py, lattice.py) with a two-channel belief and rewrites RootCourt.p_best's sampler (stillwater/court.py); extends Palimpsest.correction to export its posterior variance and Engine._integrate to accumulate shared-evidence counts.

title: Theorem-preserving tiered eviction with a link-integrity protocol
summary: v0 eviction is lattice.clear() mid-think: at 2.5M nodes â€” reachable in long games precisely because persistence-within-game is a feature â€” it discards every proven mate, every settled belief, and the root's evidence, then restarts from a single oracle eval; the engine throws away its theorems and keeps its gossip (only the palimpsest survives). Design now: (i) a proof ledger â€” a compact, eviction-exempt map of key â†’ certificate + certifying move, consulted like a private tablebase; (ii) selective eviction ranked by root-reachability Ã— evidence mass Ã— staleness, with an explicit link-integrity protocol: evicting X must null the child_keys slots referencing X in its parents (so FPU correctly treats the move as unexpanded), remove X from its children's parent sets, and dirty-mark X's parents â€” under partial eviction, dangling parent back-pointers silently sever the settling engine's only propagation channel, and a parent still pointing at a freed key would resurrect stale beliefs if the key is later re-created with different contents. Trigger: converting a found mate across several moves while the pond is full â€” today the proof is wiped mid-conversion and the engine may re-choose a non-converting move on starvation rations.
why_this_architecture: In this design eviction is not memory management, it is epistemics: 're-rooting is a no-op' and 'transpositions are free' are load-bearing promises that clear-the-world breaks, and parent back-pointer integrity is a correctness invariant of the dirty-queue contraction, not a bookkeeping nicety. It must be co-designed with the proof-revocation flow (eviction of a certifying child is one of the retraction triggers) and decided before the compiled core freezes the node layout â€” which slots exist for links and certificates is exactly the kind of thing the rewrite will make permanent.
replaces_or_extends: Replaces the over_capacity clear() branch in Engine.think (stillwater/engine.py) and Lattice's flat dict store; extends Node's link fields; co-designed with the proof-certificate revocation flow.
